[i][b]The Oceanice Republic's annexation of Goleornacha[/b]

Disputes on how to distribute resources and claims of corruption among the ruling clique led to many protests. The indigenous majority wanted more autonomy and sovereignty over the island's resources, whereas settler communities wanted closer relationships with outside powers for economic safety. Sensing an opportunity, the Oceanice Republic made a concerted effort to approach the island's divided leaders, offering aid and mediation. Reports of covert backing for factions more aligned with Oceanice interests continued to destabilize the region.
On 21 May 2025, the Oceanice Republic launched "Operation Blue Tides," a military intervention labeled a humanitarian mission to restore order and stability. The operation included a naval blockade, rapid deployment of over 25,000 troops to secure strategic locations, and a media campaign that highlighted the chaos in Goleornacha but presented Oceanice as a stabilizing force. The military operation faced little opposition as the divided leadership of the island found it difficult to organize a defense. In two weeks, Goleornacha was reported captured by Oceanice troops.

Though most countries denounced the annexation, the Oceanice Republic worked hard on its diplomacy. It promised billions of dollars' worth of investment in Goleornacha's economy and infrastructure, and there were some leaders among its people who stood behind them. Oceanice also succeeded in persuading some of the surrounding states to remain neutral or silently acquiesce by signing trade pacts and political deals. Despite fierce disapproval from powerful nations and sanctions from international organizations, the Republic used its growing economic power to mitigate the effects.

On June 15, 2025, the Oceanice Republic voted on what to do with Goleornacha. The vote was overseen by Oceanice authorities, and it appeared that most individuals wished to join Oceanice. But international observers stated that the vote was not free or fair. The Republic announced that Goleornacha became part of it on July 1, 2025.[/i]
